name: Zhejiang University College of Optical Science and Engineering Scholarship
host: Zhejiang University, College of Optical Science and Engineering
fields: Optical engineering, optical communication, information sensing and instruments
note: For international applicants admitted to the College's PhD programmes; apply via the ZJU online system plus a College form. The 2026 round closed 28 Feb 2026.

name: USTC Fellowship for Undergraduate Programs
host: University of Science and Technology of China (USTC)
amount: Level A: tuition waiver + medical insurance + RMB 2,500/month + accommodation subsidy (lower levels give less)
fields: USTC undergraduate programmes (science and engineering focus)
note: Levels A–C; Level A is the full package. The 2026 window ran 14 Nov 2025 – 31 Mar 2026.

name: USTC Fellowship for Master's Programs
host: University of Science and Technology of China (USTC)
amount: Tuition + insurance + up to RMB 3,000/month + accommodation subsidy
note: Apply through the USTC international online application system. The 2026 window ran 16 Oct 2025 – 31 Jan 2026.

name: USTC Fellowship for Doctoral Programs
host: University of Science and Technology of China (USTC)
amount: Level A (CAS-funded): tuition waiver + medical insurance + up to RMB 7,000/month; Levels B/C smaller stipend + housing help
note: Three levels; Level A is funded by the Chinese Academy of Sciences. The 2026 window ran 16 Oct 2025 – 31 Jan 2026.

name: SJTU Scholarship / SJTU Fellowship for International Graduate Students
amount: PhD SJTU Fellowship: tuition waiver + RMB 5,000/month; SJTU Scholarship / Tuition Waiver: full or partial tuition
note: Selected from the main graduate application at apply.sjtu.edu.cn; you cannot also apply via an embassy. The Fellowship is for doctoral students; master's awards range from partial to full tuition.

name: Keio "Design the Future" Award for International Students
amount: Full tuition and fees + JPY 200,000/month + JPY 150,000 one-time grant
dlText: Set by each graduate school (last cycle's final interviews were in Dec 2025); check your school's page
note: Up to 2 years for master's and 3 years for PhD. Each graduate school picks nominees, then a steering committee interviews them; some schools invite candidates only.

name: Kyushu University Intellectual Exchange and Innovation Program (MEXT, Category D-a)
amount: MEXT scholarship: tuition + monthly stipend (MEXT rate) + travel

eligibility.note: Nationals of countries with diplomatic relations with Japan; priority to Southeast Asian nationals; not a MEXT scholar in the past 3 years

note: University-recommended MEXT doctoral track with preference for Southeast Asian applicants. The 2027-intake round closed on 17 Sep 2026.

name: Nagoya University Global 30 Undergraduate Scholarship
amount: Full tuition for 4 years + JPY 500,000 stipend in total
dlText: 2nd round 21 Jan 2027 for some programmes (time not stated); 1st round closed 19 Nov 2026
fields: G30 programmes (sciences, engineering, social sciences, humanities)
note: Submit the scholarship form with the G30 application. Applicants are also considered for University Recommendation MEXT; some programmes have no 2nd round.

name: Kyoto University International Undergraduate Program (Kyoto iUP) Scholarship
amount: Admission + tuition fees waived + up to JPY 120,000/month merit scholarship
fields: Kyoto University undergraduate faculties (taught in Japanese after prep course)
note: 4.5-year programme with a 6-month Japanese preparatory course; no Japanese needed at entry. Some places get MEXT (University Recommendation).

name: NCKU Veritas et Conscientia Scholarship (PhD)
amount: Full tuition waiver + monthly stipend (up to NT$25,000–30,000) + NT$8,000 advisor fund
note: NCKU's flagship award for international PhD students; official pages disagree on the stipend cap, so check the current guideline.

name: NCKU Distinguished International Student Scholarship
amount: Graduate: full tuition waiver + monthly stipend set by college; undergraduate: tuition waiver and stipend by ranking
note: Considered automatically when you apply for admission; the award is mailed with the admission letter.

name: NTU Outstanding International Graduate Student Scholarship
amount: Tuition up to NT$130,000/year (+ NT$2,000/month for some colleges)
dlText: 2nd round (Sept 2027 entry): opens 1 Dec 2026; closes 19 Jan 2027, 16:00 GMT+8 per the admission guidelines (the admissions site says 28 Jan); 1st round closed 19 Nov 2026
note: Recommended by colleges from admitted international graduate students. Cannot be combined with other NTU or Taiwanese government scholarships.

name: Chulalongkorn University Graduate Scholarship Programme for ASEAN or Non-ASEAN Countries
amount: University tuition + THB 16,000/month stipend & accommodation + capped airfare
dlText: ~mid-May 2027 for 1st semester (estimated from past cycles); faculty deadlines are earlier
note: 2-year master's / 3-year PhD. Submit to your faculty at least 2 weeks before the university deadline via grantgateway.research.chula.ac.th; stipend only paid while in Thailand.

name: Mahidol Postgraduate Scholarships for International Students
host: Mahidol University, Faculty of Graduate Studies
amount: Tuition fees + some additional expenses (check official page)
dlText: Apply through your programme; deadlines set per programme
fields: Most Mahidol graduate programmes (medicine faculties, ICT, MUIC, music, management excluded)
note: 2026 edition shown; contact your intended programme for its internal scholarship schedule.

name: CMB-Mahidol Postgraduate Scholarship (Mekong Region)
amount: Tuition + living expenses + stipend + one return economy airfare
dlText: ~17 Apr 2027, estimated from 2026 cycle (16 Mar – 17 Apr 2026)
note: For nationals of Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar and Vietnam; some tracks need health-sector work experience. Level wording is 'postgraduate', so check whether doctoral places are offered.

name: Samsung Global Sungkyun Scholarship
amount: Full tuition for 8 semesters; Type A adds KRW 500,000/month living expenses
dlText: Nominated from newly admitted students; follows SKKU international admission dates
note: Not applied for separately: SKKU nominates outstanding new international admits, with an interview if needed. Other admits can get 50–100% first-semester waivers if they rank in the top 10%.

name: Hanyang Scholarship for Engineering and Science Students (Graduate)
amount: 50% of tuition and 50% of admission fee (up to 4 semesters for master's)
dlText: 18 Sep 2026 for Spring 2027 (time not stated, closed)
fields: Engineering and natural sciences graduate programmes
note: Given to international students admitted to engineering and science graduate programmes; amounts come from the 2024 guideline, so check the current one.
